featured_techniques.technique: Company-wide reliability rating of customer experience stages
Focusing on improving the customer's life to drive advocacy and repeat business

sections.description: The speaker emphasizes that teams should unite the leadership before tackling projects, noting that leaders often measure success by their own metrics. The recommended approach is to bring the leadership together to assess the reliability of each stage of the customer experience from a company-wide perspective, aiming to create a truly one company experience that improves customers' lives and prompts advocacy.
sections.title: Leadership alignment as the first step before projects

summary: The speaker argues that teams should not rush to begin projects; the first priority is to unite the leadership team because leaders often measure success using their own metrics. The recommended approach is to bring the leadership together to assess the reliability of each stage of the customer experience from a single, company-wide perspective, acknowledging that the current “one company experience” is not reliably delivered yet. The ultimate aim is to improve the customer’s life so they will share the experience with others and seek it again, thereby driving advocacy and repeat engagement.
title: Uniting the C-Suite as the First Step in Elevating Customer Experience
topics: rating reliability of customer journey stages
